structure.unit: Rabies Control and Licensing of Dogs and Cats

law.catch_line: Payment of license tax subsequent to summons
law.text: Payment of the license tax subsequent to a summons to appear before a court for failure to pay the license tax within the time required shall not operate to relieve such owner from the penalties or court costs provided under § 16.1-69.48:1 or 17.1-275.7.
